title: Sum formulas
text: The sum of i from $$1$$ to $$n$$ is $$\frac{n\left(n+1\right)}{2}$$, and the sum of $$i^2$$ from $$1$$ to $$n$$ is $$\frac{n\left(n+1\right) \left(2n+1\right)}{6}$$.

title: Subtract the first four terms
text: The sum from $$5$$ to $$10$$ equals the sum from $$1$$ to $$10$$ minus the sum from $$1$$ to $$4$$, which is $$55-10=45$$.
